name: spartan-gate
description: A private security gate for Hermes-class agents.

scripts.test:route: python3 -m unittest discover -s infra/spartan-route -p 'test_*.py' && node --test infra/spartan-route/test_*.js
scripts.test:camofox: python3 -m unittest discover -s infra/camofox -p 'test_*.py' && node --import ./infra/camofox/test-keepalive.mjs --test infra/camofox/test_*.js infra/camofox/test_*.mjs
scripts.test:pi: python3 -m unittest discover -s infra/pi -p 'test_*.py' && node --test infra/pi/test_*.mjs
scripts.test:hermes:native: python3 -c "import os, pathlib, unittest; root = pathlib.Path(os.environ['HERMES_UPSTREAM_SOURCE']); assert pathlib.Path(os.environ['HERMES_SYNC_SOURCE']).resolve() == (root / 'tools/skills_sync.py').resolve(); suite = unittest.TestSuite(unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('apps/hermes-agent', pattern=name) for name in ['test_external_skill_links_patch.py', 'test_upstream_refresh.py', 'test_camofox_only_variant.py', 'test_camofox_managed_policy_patch.py', 'test_spartan_browser_policy.py', 'test_camofox_vault_patch.py', 'test_spartan_fast_mode_patch.py', 'test_portable_plan_patch.py', 'test_skill_selection_guidance_patch.py']); result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite); raise SystemExit(not result.wasSuccessful() or bool(result.skipped))"
scripts.test:camofox:native: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const key of ['CAMOFOX_UPSTREAM_SOURCE', 'CAMOFOX_EXPRESS_MODULE']) { if (!process.env[key] || !fs.existsSync(process.env[key])) throw Error('missing native input: ' + key); }" && node --import ./infra/camofox/test-keepalive.mjs --test infra/camofox/test_*.js infra/camofox/test_*.mjs
